## Release checklist

- [ ] Review the generated version and changelog.
- [ ] Update `version-code.txt` to the code derived from `version.txt`.
- [ ] Add non-empty localized release notes under `fastlane/metadata/android/{en-US,zh-CN}/changelogs/<versionCode>.txt`.
- [ ] Approve and pass Android CI before merging.
